description: 克隆 MiniOneRec 仓库、配置多节点环境、启动 MIND SFT pointwise 训练

commands.name: 删除旧的 MiniOneRec 目录
commands.description: 如果已存在则删除，确保干净克隆

commands.name: 启动 SFT 训练
commands.command: MODEL_PATH={model_path} DATA_ROOT={data_root} OUTPUT_DIR={output_root} BATCH_SIZE={batch_size} MICRO_BATCH_SIZE={micro_batch_size} NUM_EPOCHS={num_epochs} NEG_RATIO={neg_ratio} MAX_HISTORY={max_history} USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE={use_chat_template} USE_ABSTRACT={use_abstract} bash scripts/sft_mind_pointwise_ds.sh

commands.name: 运行模型评估
commands.description: 训练完成后自动评估模型（如果 run_eval=1）
commands.command: if [ "{run_eval}" = "1" ]; then CHECKPOINT_DIR=$(ls -td {output_root}/sft_mind_pointwise_* 2>/dev/null | head -1) && if [ -n "$CHECKPOINT_DIR" ]; then echo "=== 开始模型评估 ===" && echo "Checkpoint: $CHECKPOINT_DIR" && mkdir -p $CHECKPOINT_DIR/eval_results && MIND_SIZE=$(echo {data_root} | grep -q 'large' && echo 'large' || echo 'small') && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7 MIND_SIZE=$MIND_SIZE MIND_ROOT={data_root} USE_CHAT_TEMPLATE={use_chat_template} USE_ABSTRACT={use_abstract} MAX_HISTORY={max_history} BATCH_SIZE=8 OUTPUT_FILE=$CHECKPOINT_DIR/eval_results/{eval_split}_pointwise_predictions.txt bash scripts/eval_mind_pointwise.sh $CHECKPOINT_DIR {eval_split} && echo "=== 评估结果已保存到 $CHECKPOINT_DIR/eval_results/ ==="; else echo "ERROR: No checkpoint found in {output_root}"; fi; else echo '=== 跳过评估 (run_eval=0) ==='; fi

commands.name: 调试模式-保持容器运行
commands.description: 保持容器运行以便进入调试，完成后可手动取消任务
commands.command: echo '=== 调试模式: 容器将保持运行，可通过 AML Portal 进入容器调试 ===' && sleep infinity
